# v0.10.0b5 — The app catches up

- The app's **Charging** page sets and shows the cost ceiling, and the overview names the amount beside its energy target. Home Assistant reports every price change to the app, which arms an amount at the last reported price; without configured charging costs the field stays locked.
- App: a command refused because it has to wait behind a waiting stop or the write interval, and a target time in the past, are named as such instead of reading "Save not confirmed".
- App: a guest charge interrupted by a restart asks for a new guest start; the Charging page shows the departure plan's status beside its time.

Update the app and the integration to **0.10.0b5** together. The cost target is not yet tested on real hardware.

Every contribution is voluntary and very welcome; support and new features stay open to everyone either way.
